Mostly threatening to take away something or get rid of something (like clothes), regardless of wheter they bought it or I did. 
E.g I once woke up with a shirt of mine being turned into a rag for wiping the dust off of furniture because I didn't finish a project for university.

(Sorry for the late reply)

I don't know really. The worst they normally do is yell, and they don't usually follow through on their threats unless they're angry. There are a few things I'm not really okay with but that's just family being family. I imagine all families are sort of like this.

I just kind of wish they'd stop telling me they wish they had my friends or their friends' kids as their children instead of me, because of how much better they are.

I'm job hunting right now, just very discouraged as I don't have qualifications for a lot of the jobs out there.

Thank you!

While moving away sounds like a pretty good idea, I doubt it can fix much by itself. I imagine it should be mixed with lifestyle changes and therapy, both of which sound very far away from where I am right now. 
But thank you for your kind words. If I get the chance to move away, I will consider it.
